items.summary: A lead agent called Fox splits a task and hands the pieces to Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, which build in real terminals. Shared memory, automatic resume after usage limits, and approvals in one place. $5 for the first month, then $12/month; Windows, macOS, and Linux.
items.title: Foxpit: a lead agent splits the work while Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode build as one team (launched on Product Hunt, Nov 11)

items.summary: Free and open source: bring your own Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other subscriptions, and assign tasks from an iPhone or iPad. A P2P encrypted connection links your phone to your desktop, where the agents do the work. Its Flowcy cloud routes tasks between local and cloud models by complexity.
items.title: RxCode: assign tasks to your coding agents from your phone over an encrypted peer-to-peer link (launched on Product Hunt, Nov 8)

items.summary: Pick a memory engine — Mem0, Graphiti, Hindsight, ReMe, or your own — and agents on different harnesses can share one memory with fine-grained access control. Available in an open-source Community Edition, with the memory layer defined by an open protocol.
items.title: Harness Memory: long-term memory for agents, shared across Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes (launched on Product Hunt, Nov 12, #7 of the day)
